record.reason: 一次資料の要旨: To address the growing computational and memory demands of deep neural networks, Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) have emerged as an efficient alternative to full-precision models. However, BNNs suffer from severe information loss during quantization and limited expressive capacity. In this study, we propose an assistive teacher and self-knowledge distillation for binary Quantization-Aware Training (ASBQ). This progressive quantization framework combines multi-bit assistive teacher models with self-knowledge distillation to stabilize BNN training. To further enhance robustness across various neural network architectures, we integrate matching structured pruning with an asymmetric Binary Weight Network scaling factor, thereby reducing quantization errors while maintaining hardware efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy of 93.1% on CIFAR-10 and performance comparable to full-precision teacher models.
record.title: Adaptive multi-bit progressive quantization for stable training of binary neural networks
